title: Airbnb limits chores for guests, sparking backlash from hosts
slides: Airbnb just capped guest chores—why now?
Hosts are pushing back hard on the new limit
Most complaints come from a small group of hosts
Check your listing's chore list against the new cap
Ask: is your checkout list a fee in disguise?
thread_text:
1. Airbnb capped guest chores

A new limit on checkout tasks has hosts furious—but data shows most complaints come from a tiny slice of them.

2. Hosts push back hard

Many say the cap ruins their cleaning routine, yet internal numbers reveal a vocal minority driving the backlash.

3. Small group, loud noise

Most hosts never complained. The pushback is concentrated among a few who rely on long chore lists to cut turnover costs.

4. Check your own list

Compare your checkout instructions to the new cap. If you're over, you're now an outlier—and guests notice.

5. Is your list a fee?

If chores save you a cleaning fee, guests pay twice. Open your listing and count: does each task replace paid work?
